home.ctaTitle: Ready to launch your next campaign?

items.a: Yes. All public creator profiles, public metrics, services and rates can be viewed without payment. Saving creators requires a free account.

items.q: Why is there a contact fee?
items.a: Initiating direct contact requires a one-time contact fee (shown before payment). It keeps enquiries serious and protects creators from spam. Booking a listed service also unlocks messaging.

items.q: Where do the statistics come from?
items.a: From official Instagram and TikTok APIs when the creator has connected their account and granted permission. Each figure shows its source, verification state and last update. Missing metrics are shown as unavailable — never estimated.

items.q: What does the performance grade mean?
items.a: A 0–100 score (S, A, B, C, D) based on verified reach, views, engagement, audience quality and consistency. It is not an identity check. Creators without enough verified data are shown as “Not Yet Rated”.
Payments are processed by a licensed payment provider. InfluenceHub records each booking, commission, VAT and creator payout separately on an immutable ledger.

items.q: Do creators need a UAE advertiser permit?
items.a: UAE rules may require creators to hold an advertiser permit for paid content. Creators can add permit details for review, but InfluenceHub's verification badges are not a legal permit.
Refunds are handled according to the contact-fee policy and booking terms. Disputes on campaigns are reviewed by our team.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.notice: Draft for legal review — not yet final.

sections.p: InfluenceHub provides a marketplace where businesses discover, contact and book creators for marketing services in the United Arab Emirates.
You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials secure. We may suspend accounts that breach these terms.
Contact fees and booking commissions are shown before payment. Prices are in AED. VAT applies where required.
Creators are responsible for complying with UAE advertising rules, including any advertiser permit requirements and disclosure of paid content.
Medical and healthcare campaigns are subject to additional compliance review and applicable health-authority advertising rules.
Disputes are reviewed by InfluenceHub. Refunds are handled according to the applicable policy and booking terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: Draft for legal review — aligned with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law principles; not yet final.

sections.p: Account details, profile information, communications, transaction records and — with your authorisation — data from connected Instagram and TikTok accounts.
To operate the marketplace, verify accounts, calculate performance grades, process payments, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations.
We only access data you authorise through official APIs. Access tokens are encrypted and you can disconnect at any time, which revokes our access.
You can access, export and request deletion of your personal data from Settings. Financial records are retained as required by law.
We use encryption, access controls, audit logging and monitoring to protect your data.
